robot: ALOHA-AgileX dual-arm robot: two 6-joint arms with parallel grippers, fixed in front of a table

frame.suite: RoboTwin world: origin at the table centre on the floor plane, +z up; the robot stands at y = -0.65 facing +y
frame.base_text: on the floor under the middle of the robot (world point (0, -0.65, 0)): +X towards the table (world +y), +Y to the robot's left (world -x), +Z up; the table top is at z = 0.74 m

control.collision_aware: end-effector goals are planned by CuRobo around the table only; objects are not obstacles to it

ee.point: RoboTwin's end-effector frame: 0.12 m behind the gripper centre along the approach axis
ee.mode_text: each goal is planned by CuRobo (table-only collision) and executed; a failed plan holds the arm

ee.point: RoboTwin's end-effector frame: 0.12 m behind the gripper centre along the approach axis
ee.mode_text: each goal is planned by CuRobo (table-only collision) and executed; a failed plan holds the arm

notes: End-effector poses (goals and state) are RoboTwin's end-effector frame, 0.12 m behind the gripper centre along the approach axis: to put the fingers at p, command p - 0.12 * approach axis. The gripper-centre pose of each arm is the proprio group tcp_pose (proprio_now, layout in describe_robot's spec_file). The reported gripper value is the command; the measured finger opening (0 = closed, 1 = open, in the joint_position units) is in the proprio group joint_pos (columns 36 and 43 of proprio_now), and a gripper closed on an object stays above 0 there. An end-effector goal that also sets the gripper moves the gripper during the arm's motion: to grasp, reach first, then close the gripper in a separate move_robot call. Each end-effector goal takes as long as the planner needs (duration_s does not apply). Static cameras: head_camera (above the table), front_camera (facing the robot), observer_camera and world_camera1; left_camera and right_camera ride on the wrists.
